name: AI Ethics Course: Candorline
subtitle: AI Fairness, Privacy, Policy
shortDescription: Eight case files, 14 live labs, equations that come alive.
longDescription:
Learn how to build AI that is fair, private and accountable. AI Ethics Course: Candorline is a university-level course for your phone in eight short case files: why ethics matters to builders, where bias comes from, measuring fairness, mitigation and trade-offs, privacy and data protection, transparency and accountability, governance and standards, and real cases.

Every idea starts with a real situation you can move around. Watch a crowd of applicants cross a hiring cut-off while demographic parity, error rates and precision update. Turn a 3D surface that shows why fairness criteria cannot all hold when base rates differ. Blur a hospital census with differential-privacy noise. Sort AI uses onto a layered risk pyramid. Then see the equation, typeset, with each coloured term linked to what you just saw.

What you get
- 14 live labs with typeset equations and a check built from your own settings
- 8 short Watch films you can pause, scrub and replay (sound is optional and off by default)
- 250+ questions with worked reasons; wrong answers return gently, nothing nags
- A reference shelf: every claim carries two checked sources (textbooks, standards, papers, university courses), openable in an in-app window
- Text size 85-200%, screen-reader labels, reduced-motion support, works offline, no account

Free with ads at natural breaks (never during a lab or question). Optional monthly ad-free subscription ($3.99, 7-day free trial). Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle. Prefer not to subscribe? Watch short videos to earn credits.

Content as of 2026-11-17. Written and source-checked by our team; not reviewed by an external expert. Laws and standards change: verify the current text. This is education, not legal advice.
